mergedParams.userDescription: Softly drawn text, watercolor fills, and gentle, floating motion. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Soft Watercolor Text with Gentle Floating Motion

prompts.prompt: Create a watercolor text animation preset that mimics the organic flow of watercolor paint spreading on wet paper. Each word should appear as if painted with a soft brush, starting from a small point and expanding outward with irregular, fluid edges. The text should have a subtle breathing animation where the watercolor 'bleeds' expand and contract gently, creating a living, organic feel. Use a combination of opacity transitions and scale transforms to simulate the water absorption effect. The letters should float upward slightly as they settle, like paint lifting off the paper before drying. Include subtle color variations within each word, transitioning between soft pastels that blend at the edges. The overall motion should feel dreamy and weightless, with each word having a slightly different float pattern to avoid mechanical repetition.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' as container. Each word as individual TextAtom wrapped in BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning. Implement watercolor effect using multiple overlapping text shadows with varying blur radius (4px, 8px, 12px) and opacity (0.3, 0.2, 0.1). Use CSS filters: blur(0.5px) initially transitioning to blur(0px), combined with contrast(0.8) and brightness(1.1) for soft edges. Animation: Generic keyframe effects with opacity 0→1 over 800ms with ease-out, scale from 0.7→1.05→1 over 1200ms using spring easing. Add continuous translateY animation from 0→-5px→0 over 3000ms loop for floating effect. Use transform-origin: center bottom for natural growth. Performance: Apply will-change: transform, opacity to each word container. Use Tailwind classes: 'mix-blend-multiply' for color blending, 'select-none pointer-events-none' for performance. Timing: Stagger each word by 150ms using relative timing offsets. Set fitDurationTo: 'children' for adaptive duration.

prompts.prompt: Design a soft, hand-drawn text preset where letters appear as if being sketched in real-time with a watercolor brush. Each character should have a subtle wobble animation to simulate the natural hand tremor of an artist. The fill should gradually appear like watercolor paint soaking into paper, starting transparent and becoming more opaque. Include gentle horizontal drifting motion, as if the text is floating on water. Add a subtle paper texture overlay that interacts with the text through blend modes. The animation should feel contemplative and artistic, with each word having slightly different timing to create an organic, non-uniform appearance. Consider adding small paint droplets that occasionally fall from letters.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout grid with 'grid gap-2 place-items-center'. Use caption data for word-level timing. Each word in BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block'. TextAtom with custom font 'Amatic SC:400:normal' or similar handwritten font. CSS: Apply SVG turbulence filter for hand-drawn effect using filter: url(#roughPaper). Use multiple text-shadow layers: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) for depth. Implement clip-path: polygon() animation for gradual reveal from left to right. Animation: Opacity keyframes 0→0.3→0.9 over 1500ms. Add continuous rotate animation -1deg→1deg→-1deg over 2000ms for wobble. TranslateX: -20px→0 over 1000ms with ease-out for drift effect. Use internal effect preset 'watercolor-fade' if available. Blend mode: 'mix-blend-darken' for paper interaction. Performance: GPU accelerate with transform: translateZ(0). Use Tailwind: 'antialiased subpixel-antialiased' for text rendering. Timing: Use caption.words timing data, add 200ms overlap between words. Set individual word duration based on word.duration from caption data.

prompts.prompt: Build a floating watercolor typography preset where text appears to be suspended in water, with gentle ripple effects passing through the letters. Each word should materialize through a soft focus pull, starting blurred and gradually sharpening while watercolor pigments seem to settle into place. The text should have a translucent quality with visible color gradients flowing through the letters. Add subtle wave-like distortions that pass through the text periodically, creating a sense of underwater movement. Include soft light refractions that occasionally glint across the letters. The overall effect should feel serene and meditative, like watching ink slowly dissolve in water.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden' container. Nested BaseLayout for each word with 'absolute transform-gpu'. Use TextAtom with gradient fill via backgroundImage style prop. Implement CSS backdrop-filter: blur(2px) for glass effect. Animation: Initial blur(8px)→blur(0px) over 2000ms ease-out for focus pull. Opacity 0→0.8 to maintain translucency. Scale 1.2→1 synchronized with blur. Add wave distortion using transform: scaleY with values 1→1.05→0.95→1 over 3000ms infinite. Apply CSS animation for gradient movement: background-position 0%→100% over 5000ms linear infinite. Effects: Use generic keyframe effects array with multiple animation ranges. Add periodic brightness effect: 1→1.2→1 over 4000ms for light glints. Performance: Use transform3d() for hardware acceleration. Apply Tailwind: 'will-change-transform backdrop-blur-sm'. Timing: Stagger words by 300ms, use fitDurationTo: 'scene' for full scene duration. Add 10% duration overlap for smooth transitions.

prompts.prompt: Create a delicate watercolor bloom effect where text emerges like flowers opening in time-lapse. Each letter should start as a tiny seed point and expand outward with organic, irregular growth patterns. The watercolor fill should spread from the center of each character, creating beautiful color bleeding at the edges. Implement a gentle swaying motion, as if the text is affected by a soft breeze. Add subtle color shifts that cycle through pastel hues, simulating the way watercolors mix on wet paper. Include occasional 'drip' effects where color seems to run down from certain letters. The animation should feel poetic and natural, with each word blooming at its own pace.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout flex with 'flex flex-wrap justify-center items-center gap-4'. Each word as BaseLayout with 'relative inline-flex'. Use TextAtom with style prop for dynamic color. CSS: Implement radial-gradient backgrounds for bloom effect. Use mask-image with radial-gradient for organic growth. Apply filter: url(#watercolor) with custom SVG filters. Animation: Scale from 0→1.1→1 over 1800ms with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for organic growth. Opacity 0→1 staggered per letter using letter-spacing animation. Add continuous rotate -2deg→2deg over 4000ms for sway. Color animation using hue-rotate(0deg)→hue-rotate(30deg) over 6000ms. Drip effect: Create occasional translateY animations on pseudo-elements. Performance: Use contain: layout style paint. Apply Tailwind: 'transform-gpu motion-safe:animate-pulse'. Timing: Use word.relativeStart from caption data, add 100ms per character delay. Internal effects: Create 'watercolor-bloom' effect preset for reuse.

prompts.prompt: Develop a soft wash typography preset where text appears as if being revealed by gentle brush strokes moving across the screen. Each word should fade in with a watercolor texture that starts highly diluted and gradually becomes more concentrated. The motion should include a subtle floating drift, moving slowly from left to right as if carried by water current. Add a paper grain texture that shows through the translucent letters. Include soft color bleeding between adjacent words, creating beautiful gradient transitions. The overall feeling should be calm and artistic, like watching an artist's watercolor painting come to life in slow motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Inner BaseLayout grid 'grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-max gap-6'. TextAtom components with watercolor texture overlay. CSS: Use mask-image: linear-gradient for brush stroke reveal from left. Apply mix-blend-mode: multiply for paper texture interaction. Multiple box-shadow layers for soft edges: inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Background: linear-gradient with stops at 0%, 50%, 100% for color variation. Animation: Mask position -100%→100% over 2500ms ease-in-out for reveal. Opacity 0.3→0.9 synchronized with mask. TranslateX: -10px→10px over 8000ms ease-in-out infinite for drift. Add filter brightness(0.9)→brightness(1.1) for concentration effect. Performance: Use CSS containment and layer creation hints. Tailwind: 'backdrop-filter backdrop-blur-[1px]' for depth. Timing: Sequential reveal with 500ms overlap between words. Use fitDurationTo: 'audio' if audio source present.

prompts.prompt: Design a dreamy watercolor text animation where words materialize through soft color clouds that coalesce into readable text. Start with abstract watercolor splashes that gradually form into letters, maintaining some of the organic, flowing quality of the initial splash. Each word should have a gentle pulsing animation, as if breathing. Add subtle chromatic aberration effects to simulate the way watercolors can separate into component colors at the edges. Include floating particles or color specks that drift around the text. The movement should be hypnotic and fluid, with overlapping animations creating a constantly evolving visual.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center'. Nested containers for particle effects using absolute positioning. TextAtom with blur and opacity transitions. Particle system using multiple small BaseLayout elements. CSS: Initial filter: blur(20px) contrast(0.5) brightness(1.2). Text-shadow with RGB channel offsets for chromatic aberration: 2px 0 0 rgba(255,0,0,0.3), -2px 0 0 rgba(0,255,255,0.3). Use CSS custom properties for dynamic color values. Animation: Blur 20px→0px over 3000ms ease-out. Contrast 0.5→1 and brightness 1.2→1 synchronized. Scale with breathing: 1→1.05→1 over 4000ms ease-in-out infinite. Particles: Random translateX/Y animations over 10000ms. Effects: Use waveform effects if audio present for reactive pulsing. Performance: Limit particle count to 10-15 for optimization. Use transform: translate3d() for GPU acceleration. Timing: Stagger word appearance by 400ms. Use internal 'cloud-formation' effect preset.

prompts.prompt: Create a gentle ink-in-water effect where text appears as if ink is being dropped into clear water and slowly forming words. The letters should have fluid, organic edges that shift and flow subtly. Implement a dispersion effect where the color initially spreads wide before contracting into the final letter shapes. Add slow rotation and scaling that creates a sense of depth, as if viewing the text through water. Include subtle color gradients that shift from the center to edges of each character. The animation should feel meditative and graceful, with smooth, continuous motion throughout.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout scene type with sequential word containers. Each word: BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block mx-2'. TextAtom with custom rendering for fluid edges. CSS: Use SVG filters for turbulence: feTurbulence baseFrequency='0.02'. Apply feGaussianBlur with animated stdDeviation. Implement feColorMatrix for color dispersion. Gradient: radial-gradient from center with animated color stops. Animation: Initial scale(2) blur(15px)→scale(1) blur(0px) over 2500ms. Continuous rotate(0deg)→rotate(360deg) over 20000ms linear infinite. Color stops animate: 0% 30% 100%→0% 50% 100% for gradient shift. Add translateZ for 3D depth: 0px→50px→0px over 5000ms. Performance: Use CSS contain: layout. Enable GPU rasterization with will-change: filter, transform. Tailwind: 'mix-blend-screen' for luminous effect. Timing: Each word starts 600ms after previous. Total duration from fitDurationTo: 'parent'.

prompts.prompt: Build a watercolor typography preset with paint splatter effects where text emerges from artistic paint drops. Each letter should appear to be painted with varying brush pressure, creating thick and thin strokes. Add a wet-on-wet watercolor effect where colors blend naturally at touching points. Include subtle paper texture bleeding through the translucent paint. Implement gentle tilting animations as if the paper is being moved while the paint is still wet. Add occasional paint drips that fall from letters. The overall aesthetic should be artistic and handcrafted, celebrating the imperfections of watercolor painting.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br'. Text container: 'flex flex-wrap gap-3 p-8'. Each word: BaseLayout with paint splatter children. TextAtom with variable font-weight animation. CSS: Use font-variation-settings for weight animation: 'wght' 300→700. Multiple overlapping text elements with different opacities for depth. Paint splatters: Absolute positioned divs with border-radius: 40% 60% 60% 40%. Animation: Font weight oscillation over 3000ms. Opacity layers: 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 with different timing. Tilt: rotateX(-5deg)→rotateX(5deg) rotateY(-3deg)→rotateY(3deg) over 6000ms. Drips: Occasional translateY(0)→translateY(30px) with opacity fade. Effects: Use internal 'paint-splatter' effect preset. Add 'wet-blend' effect for color mixing. Performance: Composite layers for each word. Use Tailwind: 'transform-style-preserve-3d'. Timing: Stagger by 250ms, match duration to caption.duration if available.

prompts.prompt: Design a flowing script watercolor preset where text writes itself in elegant, connected cursive with watercolor fills that bloom after each stroke. The animation should simulate a calligrapher's hand movement, with smooth acceleration and deceleration. Each word should have flowing watercolor gradients that shift and blend as the text appears. Add a subtle parallax effect where different parts of the text move at slightly different speeds during gentle floating animation. Include soft focus pulls that occasionally sweep across the text. The motion should be sophisticated and fluid, like watching a master calligrapher work with watercolors.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative h-full w-full flex items-center justify-center'. SVG path animation for script writing effect. TextAtom with mask-image for reveal. Gradient overlays using absolute positioned divs. CSS: Use stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset for write-on effect. Implement mask: linear-gradient for directional reveal. Apply filter: drop-shadow for depth instead of box-shadow. Cursive font: 'Dancing Script:700:normal' or similar. Animation: Stroke-dashoffset from 100% to 0 over 2000ms with cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1). Watercolor bloom: scale(0.8)→scale(1.1)→scale(1) with opacity fade-in. Parallax: Different translateY speeds: -10px, -15px, -20px over 5000ms. Focus pull: blur(0)→blur(2px)→blur(0) sweep across text. Performance: Use SVG path optimization. GPU accelerate with translateZ(0). Tailwind: 'bg-gradient-to-r bg-clip-text'. Timing: Chain animations with 30% overlap. Use mathematical easing for natural hand movement.

prompts.prompt: Create a misty watercolor text effect where words emerge from and disappear into soft fog, with watercolor pigments that seem to condense from the mist. Each letter should have a ghostly, ethereal quality with semi-transparent watercolor washes. Implement a gentle swirling motion that makes the text appear to be floating in morning mist. Add color halos around each letter that pulse softly. Include subtle light rays that occasionally pierce through the text. The animation should evoke a dreamlike, otherworldly atmosphere with smooth, continuous transformations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Fog layers: Multiple absolute divs with gradient backgrounds. Text: BaseLayout flex with 'justify-center items-center h-full'. TextAtom with low initial opacity. CSS: Use backdrop-filter: blur(8px) for misty glass effect. Radial gradients for halos: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%). Multiple fog layers with different opacities and blend modes. Light rays: Linear gradients with animated rotation. Animation: Opacity 0→0.6→0.3 cycle over 4000ms for ghostly effect. Swirl: Combined rotateZ(0→5deg) and translateX(-20px→20px) over 7000ms. Halo pulse: box-shadow size and opacity animation. Light rays: rotate(0deg)→rotate(360deg) over 20000ms linear. Effects: Use waveform effects for audio-reactive pulsing if available. Performance: Reduce fog layers on mobile. Use transform-origin for efficient rotation. Timing: Overlap word animations by 50% for smooth flow. Set fitDurationTo: 'scene' for continuous effect.
